name: Doubt Oracle Curse
body:
You are constantly filled with a sense of doubt that can easily tip into despair or hopelessness. However, this constant doubt makes you less caring about your fears and the charms and wiles of others.

You are always subject to the doubting condition. You gain a +4 bonus on saves vs. fear and charm effects.

At 5th level, add calm emotions or lesser crushing despair (your choice) to your spells known.

At 10th level, your save bonus extends to all mind-affecting effects with the exception of despair effects.

At 15th level, you are immune to fear and charm effects.
